relations: Calm water mirrors the tree as a stable inverted silhouette beneath the horizon line.
A small bright glint drifts slowly across the water half, shifting from one side of the reflection toward the other.

caption: The video captures a single leafless tree silhouetted at the horizontal center, rooted on a thin dark land line that splits the scene into sky and water. The twilight sky above fades from deep blue-black at the top to a pale glow along the horizon, scattered with faint stars. The calm surface below mirrors the tree as an inverted silhouette. Throughout the scene the tree, its reflection, the horizon line and the star field appear largely stable, with no obvious sway, translation or camera movement. The clearest motion is a small bright glint that drifts slowly across the water half of the scene, shifting from one side of the reflection toward the other. This drifting speck is accompanied by faint, minor shimmering of the mirrored image. The sky gradient and star pattern remain broadly unchanged, with no clear brightening, dimming or cloud movement discernible.
